home.title: My records
home.empty_text: When {org} links a record to you (for example your child), it appears here.
home.pending_text: You will see it here once confirmed.

record.payment_soon: Online payment will appear here when {org} offers it.

join.title: Join a portal
join.text: Enter the code from your invitation, or open the link you received.
join.bound: This invitation is for {to}. You prove it with that address.
join.name: Your name

admin.title: Portal
admin.text: Give your own people (parents, employees, customers) a portal where each sees only their own records.
admin.no_active: No one is linked yet. Invite someone to start.
admin.no_kinds_text: Records appear here when a module that has them (for example students or employees) is turned on.
admin.revoke_text: They stop seeing this record at once. You can invite them again later.
admin.cancel_invitation_text: The link and the code stop working at once.

dialog.title: Invite someone to the portal
dialog.text: They will see only this record. The invitation works only with the email or phone you enter, once they prove it.
dialog.name: Their name
dialog.send_hint: Off: you hand over the code yourself (printed or in person).

created.title: Invitation ready
created.text: Give them this code or link. It is shown only now.
